english: You are tiny. Anyone who walks over you will squash you flat. You stay tiny after respawning; type 'gts grow' in the console (F1) to return to normal size.
schinese: 你变小了。任何人从你身上走过都会把你踩成一滩血。复活后仍保持缩小，在控制台(F1)输入 gts grow 恢复原状。

english: Pinned under her foot! Mash JUMP to break free!
schinese: 你被踩住了！狂按跳跃键挣脱！
